lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Take this Workshop Pass and search Shadow Caves for the Luminous Shard. Bring it back and I'll stabilize the lift to Dragon Peak.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You found it. With this shard tuned, the peak lift will answer your sigil. Take these supplies and keep climbing.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The cave gate will open for the Workshop Pass. Find the Luminous Shard and watch for old scout caches.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Your bots are carrying real momentum now. The lift to Dragon Peak should answer the sigil I tuned for you.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Mira's pass should get you into the caves. Once you're inside, keep right at the broken pillars.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: The frontier opens in layers. Keep one eye on your party order and the other on the sky.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Bram wants the watchtower online? Good. Take these alignment notes back to him. Once the lamps are synced, we can start seeing farther than the gate.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: One of the watchtower crates held an intact Artificer frame. It isn't fit for the line yet, but it can travel with you if you want to bring it online.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Mira won't let anyone near the lift until the cave shard is secured.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The mountain lift is humming again. When you're ready, Dragon Peak is waiting.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: I saw a strange cache deeper in. It was tucked beyond the central pillar where the cave forks east.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: That glow in your pack means you found the cache. Head back before the tunnels shift.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Dragon Peak's reactors are starving. Search the ridge for a Sun Core and we'll relight the old warding pylons.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Perfect. The Sun Core is stable. Take this reward and keep pushing outward. The whole frontier is starting to wake up.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The Sun Core should be stashed past the wind-broken ridge on the eastern path.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You've done more than reopen the lift. The frontier feels alive again.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: That shard stabilized the old forge rails. With a little calibration, I can reopen the workshop line for advanced components.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Survey cradle's half buried, but not dead. Give me a minute and I'll kick it back online. Tell Nia the drones are hers again.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: If you find old parts in the wild, bring them here and I can rebuild them.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Travelers leave rumors behind. One says there is a buried vault east of town. Start with the herbalist's walls.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: So the rumor was true. Good crews always test the hidden seams of a place.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Now that the peak relays are live again, I can chart farther routes. Toma just needs someone to kick the old survey drone cradle back awake.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Perfect. The survey drones are airborne again, which means safer routes, better supply calls, and one less blind frontier.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Travelers leave rumors behind. Keep listening.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Rest when you can. Even machines need a rhythm.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: With the lift alive again, we can finally power the old watchtower. Tor still has the alignment notes if you're willing to carry them over.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: That's the last of it. The watchtower lamps are online again, and Ironhaven won't feel quite so small tonight.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Hidden chests react to careful eyes. Walk close and watch the outline flicker. And if you find an intact medic frame, I'll patch it into your crew.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: There. The support frame is stable again. It will follow your commands from here on out.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Hidden chests react to careful eyes. Walk close and watch the outline flicker.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: The roots around the Moonlit Glade shift every dusk. If you can map the pattern with a scan frame, we might finally reclaim the clearing.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: Follow the roots that hum back at your scanner. The glade should open if the pattern is traced cleanly.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: So the glade was real after all. Good. One less forgotten place sealed off by fear and old growth.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: Whispering Forest keeps its paths for crews that pay attention.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: The quarry's jammed sluice is blocking a maintenance lane full of salvage. If your heavy frame can wrench it loose, the whole lift route gets easier to trust.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: The sluice sits just past the crusher line. You'll need a real vanguard shove to break it free.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: There it is. Air moving through the lane again. That's what progress sounds like in a quarry.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: Every cleared machine lane becomes a road for the people after us.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: The drowned archive below still carries intact charts. Bring me whatever route key survived down there and I can point you toward the old command skies.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: Search the Archive Hull. The chart capsule should be sealed against pressure and corrosion.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: Perfect. This Archive Chart points to an air route the old world used to reach the fortress above the clouds. Take it. The sky path is yours now.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: The sea keeps memories longer than the frontier does.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The fortress rails still answer a proper command token. If the sanctum below the clouds still holds one, recover it and we'll reopen the deepest routes.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Clockwork Sanctum should still be preserving command hardware. Search the resonance vaults.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: That's it. With the Command Sigil back online, the fortress no longer feels like a dead shell. The final rails are opening.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The old command lattice was built for war, but we'll use it to rebuild routes instead.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: A final key remains outside the machine's own logic. Search the Abyssal Rift. Only the Void Key can separate memory from collapse.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: At the edge of the rift, the world forgets its own shape. That is where the key was hidden.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: The Void Key has returned to the world of form. The final conduit is stable enough for a Forge Master to pass.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Time is only another machine until it breaks.

lines.speaker: The Watcher
lines.text: You have the key, the route, and the will. Step into the final silence. Memory Lane waits, and beyond it, Origin.

lines.speaker: The Watcher
lines.text: Every repaired road ends where memory begins.

lines.speaker: Bolt Simulation
lines.text: Welcome back, challenger. Every ten floors, the dungeon will answer with a stronger test. Every return trip is a new proof of mastery.
